BeerBiceps traveled to Australia to feel the energy of cricket in a new country. In this vlog, Ranveer explores Melbourne during a IND Vs AUS cricket match, meets Indian fans who have brought their love for the game all the way from home, and shows how cricket connects people across cultures. From the roar of the stadium to heartfelt conversations with desis abroad, his episode illustrates how cricket is not just a sport, it is an emotion that brings Indians together wherever they are in the world.

#australia #india
